svg.title: The First 30 Days: Build Evidence Before Volume
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-first-thirty-days; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: The First 30 Days: Build Evidence Before Volume; subtitle: Four weekly milestones prepare a defensible merchant and ATM pilot.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values indicate the final day of each milestone. The 30-day sprint prepares acquisition and operations; first deal timing remains 1–4 months, and the funnel spans an illustrative 120-day cohort rather than this sprint.; caption: Finish the month with reviewed terms, a nested prospect cohort, tested controls, and a reconciled operating model.; stages: label: Days 1-7; value: Select sponsor and inspect contract economics; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Owner compares Schedule A schedules, residual ownership, clawbacks, reserve terms, and supported categories. Deliver a written retained-revenue model and an ATM cash-custody plan.; label: Days 8-14; value: Build qualified outreach and site evidence; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Sales contractor creates the prospect register, requests authorized statements, and surveys suitable venues. Deliver stage definitions, pricing worksheets, and documented placement requirements without counting unsigned prospects as revenue.; label: Days 15-21; value: Test boarding, pricing, and service controls; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Operations contractor configures IRIS CRM and residual imports; field specialist tests telemetry and ATM fee disclosure. Record debit-pricing tests, dispute escalation ownership, and sponsor submission completeness.; label: Days 22-30; value: Submit pilots and reconcile readiness; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Submit complete applications and negotiate placement terms. If accepted and installed, verify live results; otherwise record sponsor dependencies. Reconcile startup cash, fixed overhead, and all three canonical profit cases.

rect.title: label: Days 1-7; value: Select sponsor and inspect contract economics; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Owner compares Schedule A schedules, residual ownership, clawbacks, reserve terms, and supported categories. Deliver a written retained-revenue model and an ATM cash-custody plan.

text.title: Select sponsor and inspect contract economics

rect.title: label: Days 8-14; value: Build qualified outreach and site evidence; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Sales contractor creates the prospect register, requests authorized statements, and surveys suitable venues. Deliver stage definitions, pricing worksheets, and documented placement requirements without counting unsigned prospects as revenue.

text.title: Build qualified outreach and site evidence

rect.title: label: Days 15-21; value: Test boarding, pricing, and service controls; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Operations contractor configures IRIS CRM and residual imports; field specialist tests telemetry and ATM fee disclosure. Record debit-pricing tests, dispute escalation ownership, and sponsor submission completeness.

text.title: Test boarding, pricing, and service controls

rect.title: label: Days 22-30; value: Submit pilots and reconcile readiness; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Submit complete applications and negotiate placement terms. If accepted and installed, verify live results; otherwise record sponsor dependencies. Reconcile startup cash, fixed overhead, and all three canonical profit cases.

text.title: Assumptions: Numeric values indicate the final day of each milestone. The 30-day sprint prepares acquisition and operations; first deal timing remains 1–4 months, and the funnel spans an illustrative 120-day cohort rather than this sprint.
